metadata.description: Machine-readable falsification test registry. Each entry defines a falsifiable assumption, the strategy for testing it, and mappings to domains, OI-IDs, and case studies. Tests are assigned F-IDs and can be referenced by test files via the @falsification_id tag.
metadata.tagging_convention: Add a comment '# @falsification_id: F-XXX-NNN' at the top of any test that implements or covers a falsification test listed here.

falsification_tests.title: sha256 is byte-identical across platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: hashlib.sha256 of a fixed byte string returns the same hex digest on every OS/Python version.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Different hex digest produced on any CI runner.
falsification_tests.strategy: Hash a fixed seed; compare against a canonical expected value.

falsification_tests.title: int64 arithmetic matches known vectors
falsification_tests.assumption: Python int64 two's-complement arithmetic and struct.unpack produce identical values on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any computed value ≠ expected vector.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pre-compute known (seed, index, expected_int64) triples; assert equality.

falsification_tests.title: pathlib normalises path separators
falsification_tests.assumption: pathlib.Path correctly resolves relative paths and normalises separators on all platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Wrong path-parts count or values.
falsification_tests.strategy: Construct a Path with forward slashes; assert parts match expected tuple.

falsification_tests.title: stdout is UTF-8
falsification_tests.assumption: stdout/stderr encoding is UTF-8 (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 is honoured).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Encoding name is not 'utf-8' or 'utf_8'.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inspect sys.stdout.encoding; assert UTF-8.

falsification_tests.title: struct.pack is little-endian
falsification_tests.assumption: struct.pack('<q', value) encodes int64 in little-endian byte order regardless of host endianness.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any byte sequence ≠ expected.
falsification_tests.strategy: Pack known values; compare against expected byte strings.

falsification_tests.title: Shader compilation is deterministic across runs
falsification_tests.assumption: Compiling the same GLSL/HLSL/SPIR-V source twice produces byte-identical output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Binary hash differs between two compilation invocations.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compile a canonical test shader twice in the same process; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2). Also compare across backends (Vulkan/Metal/D3D via cross-compilation).
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use glslang or spirv-cross in subprocess; hash stdout bytes. Requires GPU or offline compiler tool.

falsification_tests.title: Lock-free atomics are sequentially consistent on target hardware
falsification_tests.assumption: Atomic operations provide sequentially-consistent ordering on all CI and production hardware targets.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A data-race or stale read is observed under a weak-memory model emulator.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run concurrent increment/read test under TSAN (ThreadSanitizer) and/or C11 weak-ordering emulator; assert zero races.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Python: use threading + events; C extension: compile with -fsanitize=thread.

falsification_tests.title: External API is reachable within SLO timeout
falsification_tests.assumption: The external weather/data API responds within the defined SLO timeout under normal network conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: API call times out or returns a non-2xx status within the SLO window.
falsification_tests.strategy: Probe the API endpoint with a small test payload; assert response within timeout. Skipped in offline/air-gapped CI.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Use requests with timeout parameter. Mark as @pytest.mark.network and skip unless NETWORK_TESTS=1 env var is set.

falsification_tests.title: Secret-dependent polynomial arithmetic is constant-time
falsification_tests.assumption: The implementation of PQC polynomial arithmetic does not leak timing information correlated with secret key bits.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: dudect or ctgrind reports a statistically significant timing leak (p < 0.001).
falsification_tests.strategy: Run dudect over 1M samples of the target function with random secrets; assert Welch's t < 5.
falsification_tests.implementation_notes: Requires ctgrind or Python ctypes wrapper around dudect. Computationally expensive; run on dedicated CI job.

falsification_tests.title: Noise PSK zero-key is rejected
falsification_tests.assumption: The library enforces PSK ≠ 0^32 at the API boundary.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Library accepts a 32-byte all-zero PSK without raising an error.
falsification_tests.strategy: Call the PSK-setting API with bytes(32); assert a ValueError or ProtocolError is raised.

falsification_tests.title: Compiled binary contains stack canaries
falsification_tests.assumption: All safety-critical C binaries are compiled with stack-protector flags (-fstack-protector-strong).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: objdump/readelf shows no __stack_chk_fail import in the binary.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run readelf -s on the target binary; assert __stack_chk_fail is present.

falsification_tests.title: XSS payload is neutralized before HTML output
falsification_tests.assumption: All user-supplied Markdown/HTML passes through a context-aware sanitizer before being rendered.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A canonical XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>) appears unescaped in rendered output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Submit the canonical payload through the rendering pipeline; assert the output contains no literal <script> tag.

falsification_tests.title: ASI loader slot is exclusive (no dual-loader conflict)
falsification_tests.assumption: Only one ASI loader DLL can occupy the loader interception point in a game process.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two ASI loaders are present in the game directory simultaneously without conflict detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Scan game directory for known ASI loader filenames (dinput8.dll, dsound.dll, etc.); assert at most one is present.

falsification_tests.title: Dosimetry calculation matches reference implementation within tolerance
falsification_tests.assumption: The software dosimetry calculation agrees with the IEC 62304 reference algorithm within ±0.1%.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Computed dose deviates from reference by more than 0.1%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Feed a canonical patient-phantom dataset through both implementations; assert relative error < 0.001.

falsification_tests.title: PLC cycle-time is within real-time bound
falsification_tests.assumption: The PLC control loop completes each cycle within the specified real-time deadline.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any cycle exceeds the deadline budget.
falsification_tests.strategy: Instrument the control loop with high-resolution timers; assert max(cycle_times) ≤ deadline_ms.

falsification_tests.title: Worker safety alert delivered within required latency
falsification_tests.assumption: Worker safety alerts are delivered within the required response time.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alert delivery latency exceeds the required bound.
falsification_tests.strategy: Measure end-to-end alert delivery time under simulated load; assert max latency ≤ bound.

falsification_tests.title: Document processing pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: Document processing pipelines are idempotent.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical input produce different output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run the pipeline twice with identical input; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: HFT order-book state is deterministic
falsification_tests.assumption: HFT order-book state is deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Replay test produces different fills.
falsification_tests.strategy: Replay a recorded market-event sequence twice; assert identical fill records.

falsification_tests.title: Dispatch system handles network partition without data loss
falsification_tests.assumption: Dispatch systems handle network partitions without data loss.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A message is lost or duplicated during simulated partition.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate network partition; assert all messages are delivered exactly once after partition heals.

falsification_tests.title: Infrastructure control software meets SIL requirements
falsification_tests.assumption: All control-system software meets IEC 61508 SIL requirements.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Formal SIL assessment is absent or fails.
falsification_tests.strategy: Assert presence of a signed SIL certificate in the ontology evidence store.

falsification_tests.title: ETL pipeline is idempotent
falsification_tests.assumption: ETL pipelines are idempotent: re-running produces the same output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Row count or aggregate differs between two runs.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run ETL twice; assert row counts and checksums are identical.

falsification_tests.title: Game save data is forward-compatible across versions
falsification_tests.assumption: Saved game data is forward-compatible with new versions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Save file from version N fails to load in version N+1.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load a canonical save file from version N in version N+1; assert no error and expected state.

falsification_tests.title: Generative output is reproducible from fixed seed
falsification_tests.assumption: Given a fixed seed, generative output is reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical seed produce different sha256 hashes.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run generator twice with fixed seed; assert sha256(output1) == sha256(output2).

falsification_tests.title: Compression round-trip is lossless
falsification_tests.assumption: Compression/decompression is lossless and reproducible.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: sha256(decompress(compress(data))) ≠ sha256(data).
falsification_tests.strategy: Compress and decompress a canonical dataset; assert sha256 equality.

falsification_tests.title: Emergency stop reaches safe state within 100ms
falsification_tests.assumption: E-stop signal propagates to all actuators within 100ms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any actuator continues operation beyond the 100ms deadline.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject e-stop signal; measure time to last actuator deactivation; assert <= 100ms.

falsification_tests.title: PLC program scan does not exceed watchdog timer
falsification_tests.assumption: Full PLC program scan completes before watchdog expiration.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Watchdog timer expires, triggering unspecified behavior.
falsification_tests.strategy: Instrument scan time; assert max_scan_time < watchdog_period * 0.95.

falsification_tests.title: Redundant sensors agree within tolerance
falsification_tests.assumption: Three redundant sensors agree within +/-0.5% of full scale.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Sensor readings diverge beyond +/-0.5% tolerance.
falsification_tests.strategy: Continuously compare sensor triplets; assert max - min <= 0.005 * full_scale.

falsification_tests.title: Safety interlock cannot be bypassed by software
falsification_tests.assumption: Physical safety interlocks override all software commands.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Software can actuate machinery while a hardware interlock is open.
falsification_tests.strategy: Attempt all control commands with interlock open; assert no actuation occurs.

falsification_tests.title: LOTO cannot be overridden remotely
falsification_tests.assumption: When LOTO is active, all remote commands are rejected.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any remote command executes despite LOTO being active.
falsification_tests.strategy: Activate LOTO; send every command type via remote interface; assert all rejected.

falsification_tests.title: Confined space atmospheric monitoring prevents unsafe entry
falsification_tests.assumption: O2, H2S, CO, LEL sensors are checked and cleared before door unlocks.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Door unlocks with unsafe atmospheric conditions present.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate hazardous atmosphere; attempt door open; assert door remains locked.

falsification_tests.title: Heavy equipment proximity detection halts within stopping distance
falsification_tests.assumption: Worker entering the danger zone triggers an immediate machine halt.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Machine continues past the specified stopping distance after detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Move test mannequin into danger zone; measure stop distance; assert <= spec.

falsification_tests.title: Implantable device rejects unauthorized commands
falsification_tests.assumption: Only authenticated clinicians can reprogram the implantable device.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Attacker can change device settings via replay or spoofing attack.
falsification_tests.strategy: Capture legitimate programming traffic; replay it; assert device rejects replayed commands.

falsification_tests.title: Infusion pump delivers within +/-5% of programmed rate
falsification_tests.assumption: Flow rate accuracy is maintained within +/-5% across all operating conditions.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Delivered volume deviates beyond +/-5% of expected over 24 hours.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run 24-hour delivery test with gravimetric measurement; assert error <= 5%.

falsification_tests.title: Ventilator alarm activates within 5 seconds of patient disconnect
falsification_tests.assumption: Patient disconnect is detected and alarmed within 5 seconds.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alarm is delayed beyond 5s or never activates after disconnect.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate patient circuit disconnect; measure time to alarm activation; assert <= 5s.

falsification_tests.title: AI diagnostic tool never suggests treatment outside clinical guidelines
falsification_tests.assumption: All AI recommendations are within approved clinical pathways.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: AI suggests a contraindicated or unapproved treatment.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run model against 10,000 edge-case scenarios; assert all outputs within approved treatment set.

falsification_tests.title: Deterministic seed produces identical game state across runs
falsification_tests.assumption: A fixed RNG seed produces an identical game state on every run.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with the same seed produce different states.
falsification_tests.strategy: Initialize game with fixed seed; record state hash after N ticks; repeat; assert hashes equal.

falsification_tests.title: Anti-cheat detects memory value manipulation
falsification_tests.assumption: Anti-cheat prevents external processes from modifying protected game memory.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: External process modifies player stats without detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate external memory write to monitored address; assert anti-cheat flags the session.

falsification_tests.title: Game state identical across different hardware platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: Save files produce identical game state on all hardware platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Loading same save on AMD vs NVIDIA produces different game outcomes.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load identical save on all supported platforms; compare serialized memory-state hashes.

falsification_tests.title: Network packets cannot trigger memory corruption
falsification_tests.assumption: All network packet parsing is bounds-checked and cannot cause out-of-bounds writes.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A crafted packet causes a crash or achieves remote code execution.
falsification_tests.strategy: Fuzz the network parser with malformed and oversized packets; assert no crashes (use ASan).

falsification_tests.title: Mod system cannot execute arbitrary code outside sandbox
falsification_tests.assumption: Mods are confined to game resources and cannot access system files.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A mod reads or writes files outside the game installation directory.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run test mod with filesystem monitoring; assert no unauthorized file access.

falsification_tests.title: Flight model produces identical results across platforms
falsification_tests.assumption: Aerodynamics calculations are deterministic: same inputs give same outputs on all OSes.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Same flight-model inputs produce different outputs on different operating systems.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run flight model test suite on Linux, Windows, macOS; compare all outputs with sha256.

falsification_tests.title: ATC communication handles malformed messages gracefully
falsification_tests.assumption: Invalid or malformed ATC messages are ignored without crashing the system.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A malformed packet causes disconnection or process crash.
falsification_tests.strategy: Send malformed ACARS/VDLM2 messages to ATC parser; assert connection remains alive.

falsification_tests.title: Weather API failure does not crash simulator
falsification_tests.assumption: Simulator continues with last-known weather data when METAR API is unavailable.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Simulator crashes or freezes when weather endpoint returns error.
falsification_tests.strategy: Block weather API at network level; verify simulator continues with cached data for >= 10 minutes.

falsification_tests.title: KDF produces identical output for identical inputs
falsification_tests.assumption: KDF (HKDF, PBKDF2, Argon2) with identical inputs always produces identical output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: KDF produces different output for same (key, salt, info) triple.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run KDF 1000 times with fixed inputs; assert all outputs are byte-identical.

falsification_tests.title: Signature verification rejects tampered messages
falsification_tests.assumption: Any modification to a signed message causes signature verification to fail.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A tampered message passes signature verification.
falsification_tests.strategy: Sign a message; flip one bit; assert verification fails.

falsification_tests.title: Encrypted data is indistinguishable from random bytes
falsification_tests.assumption: Ciphertext passes a randomness test indistinguishable from random (NIST SP 800-22).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Ciphertext fails the NIST frequency or block-frequency test.
falsification_tests.strategy: Encrypt 1MB of fixed data; run NIST SP 800-22 frequency tests; assert p-values > 0.01.

falsification_tests.title: All cryptographic operations are constant-time
falsification_tests.assumption: No secret-dependent branches or memory accesses exist in crypto primitives.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Timing analysis (dudect/ctgrind) reveals secret-dependent variation.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run dudect over >= 1M samples on all crypto primitives; assert Welch t-statistic < 5.

falsification_tests.title: Key generation is deterministic from seed
falsification_tests.assumption: Same seed always produces the same key pair.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Different key pairs generated from the same seed.
falsification_tests.strategy: Generate key pairs from fixed seed 1000 times; assert all byte-identical.

falsification_tests.title: Protocol implementations satisfy formal specification
falsification_tests.assumption: Implementation matches the RFC or formal standard in all specified behaviors.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Implementation behavior differs from formal model checker expected output.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run implementation against ProVerif or TLA+ formal model; assert all traces conformant.

falsification_tests.title: Software continues correctly after single-bit memory flip
falsification_tests.assumption: ECC memory or software redundancy corrects single-bit errors without crash or data corruption.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A single injected bit-flip causes crash or incorrect computation.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject single-bit flips into key memory regions; verify recovery and correct output.

falsification_tests.title: Watchdog timer resets hung tasks
falsification_tests.assumption: A hung task triggers the watchdog and causes a controlled reset.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A task hangs indefinitely with no watchdog response.
falsification_tests.strategy: Force test task to hang; verify watchdog reset occurs within specified timeout.

falsification_tests.title: Telemetry includes cryptographic proof of integrity
falsification_tests.assumption: All downlinked telemetry data includes a hash chain enabling tamper detection.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Telemetry data can be modified in transit without detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Modify one byte of captured telemetry; replay to witness layer; assert tampering detected.

falsification_tests.title: Fly detection accuracy >= 95% on test image set
falsification_tests.assumption: The Crusader vision system detects flies with >= 95% accuracy.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Detection rate falls below 95% on the 1000-image test set.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run detector on 1000 labeled test images; assert detected/total >= 0.95.

falsification_tests.title: Prevention rate >= 99% in live fly release test
falsification_tests.assumption: The Crusader system eliminates >= 99% of released flies within 1 hour.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: More than 1 fly survives after 1 hour (out of 100 released).
falsification_tests.strategy: Release 100 flies; count survivors after 1 hour; assert survivors <= 1.

falsification_tests.title: Detection-to-warfare activation latency < 100ms
falsification_tests.assumption: Time from fly detection to warfare subsystem activation is < 100ms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any detection event takes >= 100ms to activate warfare.
falsification_tests.strategy: Trigger fly detection events; measure time to warfare activation; assert max < 100ms.

falsification_tests.title: False positive rate < 0.1%
falsification_tests.assumption: Non-fly triggers activate the warfare system in < 0.1% of cases.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: More than 10 false activations occur in 10,000 non-fly trigger events.
falsification_tests.strategy: Present 10,000 non-fly stimuli; count warfare activations; assert activations <= 10.

falsification_tests.title: UV output is zero when door is open
falsification_tests.assumption: The UV safety interlock cuts UV power whenever the unit door is open.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: UV output is non-zero with the door open.
falsification_tests.strategy: Open unit door; measure UV irradiance; assert measured value = 0 uW/cm2.

falsification_tests.title: No spores detected outside unit after deployment
falsification_tests.assumption: Fungal spore deployment is fully contained within the unit.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any spore colony (CFU > 0) found in air samples outside the unit.
falsification_tests.strategy: Deploy spores; sample air at 6 external positions for 30 minutes; assert all < 1 CFU/m3.

falsification_tests.title: Internal temperature maintained 34-38 degrees F continuously
falsification_tests.assumption: The refrigeration system maintains 34-38 degrees F at all times.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any temperature reading outside 34-38 F over a 30-day log.
falsification_tests.strategy: Log temperature at 1-minute intervals for 30 days; assert all readings in [34, 38] F.

falsification_tests.title: All actions logged with unbroken hash chain
falsification_tests.assumption: Every Crusader action is logged in the witness layer with an unbroken SHA-256 hash chain.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any gap or broken link in the hash chain after a sequence of actions.
falsification_tests.strategy: Perform 1000 actions; verify hash chain continuity; assert no gaps.

falsification_tests.title: Compliance reports include tamper-evident hash
falsification_tests.assumption: Generated compliance reports include a verifiable SHA-256 hash of their content.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A modified report passes hash verification.
falsification_tests.strategy: Generate report; modify one byte; re-verify; assert verification fails.

falsification_tests.title: Irrigation delivery within +/-10% of setpoint
falsification_tests.assumption: Irrigation system delivers water to within +/-10% of the sensor-driven setpoint.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Delivered volume deviates beyond +/-10%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compare commanded vs measured soil moisture after 24h; assert error <= 10%.

falsification_tests.title: Fleet GPS position accurate within 5m CEP
falsification_tests.assumption: Fleet GPS position is accurate within 5 meters CEP.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Position error exceeds 5m CEP.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compare reported position against ground truth; assert CEP <= 5m.

falsification_tests.title: Smart grid demand-response actioned within 30 seconds
falsification_tests.assumption: Demand-response events are actioned within 30s of receipt.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Any DR event takes > 30s to action.
falsification_tests.strategy: Send DR event; measure time to load shed; assert <= 30s.

falsification_tests.title: Water quality sensor alerts before threshold breach
falsification_tests.assumption: Turbidity/chlorine sensors alert before violation of safe limits.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alert fires after or not at all for out-of-spec reading.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject out-of-spec reading; verify alert fires before limit crossed.

falsification_tests.title: Message delivery meets SLA under peak load
falsification_tests.assumption: P99 message latency <= 200ms under 10x normal load.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: P99 latency exceeds 200ms under load test.
falsification_tests.strategy: Load test at 10x baseline; measure P99 latency; assert <= 200ms.

falsification_tests.title: Double-spend rejected by settlement system
falsification_tests.assumption: The settlement system rejects any attempt to spend the same funds twice.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A double-spend transaction is accepted.
falsification_tests.strategy: Submit identical transaction twice concurrently; assert only one settled.

falsification_tests.title: Actuarial risk model produces consistent scores for identical inputs
falsification_tests.assumption: Risk model is deterministic: same inputs produce same risk score.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Identical inputs produce different risk scores.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run model 100 times with fixed inputs; assert all scores identical.

falsification_tests.title: Document hash unchanged after round-trip through pipeline
falsification_tests.assumption: Legal document content is preserved byte-for-byte through the pipeline.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: sha256(output) != sha256(input) for identical document.
falsification_tests.strategy: Process document through pipeline; compare sha256 of input and output; assert equal.

falsification_tests.title: Proctoring detects prohibited browser navigation
falsification_tests.assumption: Remote proctoring detects all attempts to navigate away from the exam.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Student navigates to another tab/window without detection.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate browser tab switch; assert proctoring flags the event.

falsification_tests.title: Voting system cast-as-intended verifiability
falsification_tests.assumption: Every cast vote is recorded exactly as the voter intended.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A vote is modified between voter confirmation and tally.
falsification_tests.strategy: Cast 1000 test votes with known selections; compare tally against expected; assert exact match.

falsification_tests.title: IFF system does not misclassify friendly as hostile
falsification_tests.assumption: IFF transponder correctly identifies all friendly platforms.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A friendly platform is classified as hostile.
falsification_tests.strategy: Broadcast known-friendly IFF codes; assert all classified as friendly.

falsification_tests.title: POS transaction idempotent under network retry
falsification_tests.assumption: Retrying a failed POS transaction does not result in a double charge.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Retry produces a second charge on the same card.
falsification_tests.strategy: Submit transaction; simulate failure mid-processing; retry; assert card charged exactly once.

falsification_tests.title: Room key deactivated within 5 seconds of checkout
falsification_tests.assumption: Room key cards are deactivated within 5 seconds of guest checkout.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Key remains active more than 5 seconds after checkout.
falsification_tests.strategy: Trigger checkout event; attempt key use after 5s; assert access denied.

falsification_tests.title: Structural analysis model converges to reference solution
falsification_tests.assumption: FEM structural analysis result is within 1% of the reference solution.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Computed stress/deflection differs from reference by > 1%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run analysis on canonical benchmark structure; compare to reference; assert error < 1%.

falsification_tests.title: Gas sensor triggers evacuation alarm before LEL threshold
falsification_tests.assumption: Gas sensor alerts at 20% LEL, well before the 100% LEL explosion risk.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Alarm fires after LEL exceeds 20%.
falsification_tests.strategy: Introduce controlled gas at incremental concentrations; verify alarm at 20% LEL.

falsification_tests.title: Pipeline pressure anomaly detected within 60 seconds
falsification_tests.assumption: A pressure drop indicating a leak is detected and alarmed within 60s.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Pressure anomaly is not alarmed within 60 seconds.
falsification_tests.strategy: Inject simulated pressure drop; measure time to alarm; assert <= 60s.

falsification_tests.title: Reactor thermal runaway interlock activates before critical point
falsification_tests.assumption: High-temperature interlock activates at T_alarm before T_critical is reached.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Temperature reaches T_critical without interlock activation.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate runaway; verify interlock fires at T_alarm; assert T never reaches T_critical.

falsification_tests.title: Batch record is immutable once released
falsification_tests.assumption: A released batch record cannot be modified (21 CFR Part 11 compliance).
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: A released batch record can be edited without an audit-trail entry.
falsification_tests.strategy: Attempt to edit released record; assert operation rejected or creates immutable audit entry.

falsification_tests.title: DNA sequencing pipeline reproducible from identical raw reads
falsification_tests.assumption: Given identical FASTQ input, the variant-calling pipeline produces identical VCF output.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Two runs with identical input produce different variants.
falsification_tests.strategy: Run pipeline twice with identical input and fixed seed; compare VCF outputs; assert identical.

falsification_tests.title: Robot arm stops within collision-avoidance envelope
falsification_tests.assumption: Collision-avoidance system halts the arm before contact with any obstacle.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Arm makes contact with a detected obstacle.
falsification_tests.strategy: Place obstacle in robot workspace; command arm toward it; assert arm stops before contact.

falsification_tests.title: OTA firmware update rejected if signature invalid
falsification_tests.assumption: ECU rejects any OTA update whose cryptographic signature fails verification.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: ECU installs an unsigned or incorrectly-signed firmware image.
falsification_tests.strategy: Deliver OTA package with invalid signature; assert installation rejected and old firmware retained.

falsification_tests.title: Avionics redundant channels produce byte-identical output
falsification_tests.assumption: All redundant avionics channels produce byte-identical outputs for identical inputs.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Channels produce different outputs for the same input.
falsification_tests.strategy: Feed identical inputs to all redundant channels; compare outputs; assert byte-identical.

falsification_tests.title: AIS position within certified accuracy bounds
falsification_tests.assumption: AIS-reported position is within 10m of actual vessel position.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: AIS position differs from ground truth by > 10m.
falsification_tests.strategy: Compare AIS-reported position with DGPS ground-truth; assert error <= 10m.

falsification_tests.title: Positive train control stops train before red signal
falsification_tests.assumption: PTC system halts the train before it passes a stop signal.
falsification_tests.falsifying_observation: Train passes a stop signal without intervention.
falsification_tests.strategy: Simulate overspeed approaching stop signal; verify PTC initiates brake application in time.
